title: How Many Numbers Are Smaller Than The Current Number
description: Given an array nums, for each nums[i] find out how many numbers in the array are smaller than it.
pseudocode:
1. count = new Array(101).fill(0)
2. for num in nums: count[num]++
3. for i from 1 to 100: count[i] += count[i-1]
4. res = []
5. for num in nums: res.push(num == 0 ? 0 : count[num-1])

steps.note: Initialize count array to store frequency of each number (0-100).
Count frequencies: 1 appears once, 2 appears twice, 8 appears once.
Compute prefix sums to get count of numbers strictly smaller than i.
For each number, lookup the count of smaller numbers.
